candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing 503 on /v1/reservations, which propagates as ReadTimeout/502 through order to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the redis timeout (load, saturation, network) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s across all correlated requests. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics (latency, connections, saturation) during the incident window
Inventory service logs/metrics for reserve_inventory failures
Order service logs confirming propagation of inventory 503 to gateway 502
